from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyReceivableRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's Accounts Receivable data extracted from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    receivable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The Accounts Receivable amount; numeric value for comparison")
    receivable_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the report for Accounts Receivable (e.g., '应收账款')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the financial data covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the report containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    receivable_records: list[CompanyReceivableRecord]
